title: The Diatessaron (Section 21)
breadcrumbs: Home > Fathers of the Church > The Diatessaron (Tatian) > Section 21

paragraphs.text: 1 {{BIBLE:mar 7:31}} And Jesus went out again from the border s of Tyre and Sidon, and came to the 2 sea of Galilee, towards the borders of Decapolis. {{BIBLE:mar 7:32}} And they brought unto him one dumb and deaf, and entreated him that he would lay his hand upon him and heal 3 him. {{BIBLE:mar 7:33}} And he drew him away from the multitude, and went away alone, and spat 4 upon his fingers, and thrust them into his ears, and touched his tongue; {{BIBLE:mar 7:34}} and looked 5 to heaven, and sighed, and said unto him, Be opened. {{BIBLE:mar 7:35}} And in that hour his ears 6 were opened, and the bond of his tongue was loosed, and he spoke with ease. {{BIBLE:mar 7:36}} And Jesus charged them much that they should not tell this to any man: but the more 7 he charged them, the more they increased in publishing, and marvelled much, {{BIBLE:mar 7:37}} and [Arabic, p. 82] said, This man does everything well: he made the deaf to hear, and those that lacked speech to speak.

8, 9 {{BIBLE:joh 4:4}} And while he was passing through the land of Samaria, {{BIBLE:joh 4:5}} he came to one of the cities of the Samaritans, called Sychar, beside the field which Jacob gave to Joseph to 10 his son. {{BIBLE:joh 4:6}} And there was there a spring of water of Jacob's. And Jesus was fatigued from the exertion of the way, and sat at the spring. And the time was about the 11 sixth hour. {{BIBLE:joh 4:7}} And a woman of Samaria came to draw water; and Jesus said unto 12 her, Give me water, that I may drink. {{BIBLE:joh 4:8}} And his disciples had entered into the city 13 to buy for themselves food. {{BIBLE:joh 4:9}} And that Samaritan woman said unto him, How do you, being a Jew, ask me to give you to drink, while I am a Samaritan woman? 14 {{BIBLE:joh 4:10}} (And the Jews mingle not with the Samaritans. ) Jesus answered and said unto her, If you knew the gift of God, and who this is that said unto you, Give me 15 to drink; you would ask him, and he would give you the water of life. {{BIBLE:joh 4:11}} That woman said unto him, My Lord, you have no bucket, and the well is deep: from 16 whence have you the water of life? {{BIBLE:joh 4:12}} Can it be that you are greater than our father Jacob, who gave us this well, and drank from it, and his children, and his sheep? 17 {{BIBLE:joh 4:13}} Jesus answered and said unto her, Every one that drinks of this water shall thirst 18 again: {{BIBLE:joh 4:14}} but whosoever drinks of the water which I shall give him shall not thirst for ever: but the water which I shall give him shall be in him a spring of water springing 19 up unto eternal life. {{BIBLE:joh 4:15}} That woman said unto him, My Lord, give me of this water, that 20 I may not thirst again, neither come and draw water from here. {{BIBLE:joh 4:16}} Jesus said unto her, 21 [Arabic, p. 83] Go and call your husband, and come hither. {{BIBLE:joh 4:17}} She said unto him, I have no 22 husband. {{BIBLE:joh 4:18}} Jesus said to her, You said well, I have no husband: five husbands have you had, and this man whom you have now is not your husband; and 23 in this you said truly. {{BIBLE:joh 4:19}} That woman said unto him, My Lord, I perceive you to 24 be a prophet. {{BIBLE:joh 4:20}} Our fathers worshipped in this mountain; and you say that in Jerusalem 25 is the place in which worship must be. {{BIBLE:joh 4:21}} Jesus said unto her, Woman, believe me, an hour comes, when neither in this mountain, nor yet in Jerusalem, shall you worship 26 the Father. {{BIBLE:joh 4:22}} You worship that which you know not: but we worship that which 27 we know: for salvation is of the Jews. {{BIBLE:joh 4:23}} But an hour comes, and now is, when the true worshippers shall worship the Father in spirit and truth: and the Father also 28 seeks such as these worshippers. {{BIBLE:joh 4:24}} For God is a Spirit: and they that worship him 29 must worship him in spirit and in truth. {{BIBLE:joh 4:25}} That woman said unto him, I know that 30 the Messiah comes: {{BIBLE:joh 4:26}} and when he has come, he will teach us everything. Jesus said unto her, I that speak unto you am he.

31 {{BIBLE:joh 4:27}} And while he was speaking, his disciples came; and they wondered how he would speak with a woman; but not one of them said unto him, What do you seek? Or, 32 What do you speak with her? {{BIBLE:joh 4:28}} And the woman left her waterpot, and went to the 33 city, and said to the people, {{BIBLE:joh 4:29}} Come, and see a man who told me all that ever I did: 34 perhaps then he is the Messiah. {{BIBLE:joh 4:30}} And people went out from the city, and came to 35 him. {{BIBLE:joh 4:31}} And in the mean while his disciples besought him, and said unto him, Our 36, 37 master, eat. {{BIBLE:joh 4:32}} And he said unto them, I have food to eat that you know not. {{BIBLE:joh 4:33}} And the disciples said among themselves, Can any one have brought him anything to eat? 38 {{BIBLE:joh 4:34}} Jesus said unto them, My food is to do the will of him that sent me, and to accomplish 39 [Arabic, p. 84] his work. {{BIBLE:joh 4:35}} Said ye not that after four months comes the harvest? Behold, I therefore say unto you, Lift up your eyes, and behold the lands, 40 that they have become white, and the harvest is already come. {{BIBLE:joh 4:36}} And he that reaps receives his wages, and gathers the fruit of eternal life; and the sower and 41 the reaper rejoice together. {{BIBLE:joh 4:37}} For in this is found the word of truth, One sows, and 42 another reaps. {{BIBLE:joh 4:38}} And I sent you to reap that in which you have not laboured: others laboured, and you have entered on their labour.

43 {{BIBLE:joh 4:39}} And from that city many of the Samaritans believed in him because of the words 44 of that woman, who testified and said, He told me all that ever I did. {{BIBLE:joh 4:40}} And when those Samaritans came unto him, they besought him to abide with them; and he 45, 46 abode with them two days. {{BIBLE:joh 4:41}} And many believed in him because of his word; {{BIBLE:joh 4:42}} and they said to that woman, Now not because of your saying have we believed in him: we have heard and known that this truly is the Messiah, the Saviour of the world.

47, 48 {{BIBLE:joh 4:43}} And after two days Jesus went out thence and departed to Galilee. {{BIBLE:joh 4:44}} And Jesus 49 testified that a prophet is not honoured in his own city. {{BIBLE:joh 4:45}} And when he came to Galilee, the Galilæans received him.
